description: Na₂PtO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six PtO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-13°. There are two shorter (2.24 Å) and four longer (2.25 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four PtO₆ octahedra, edges with four PtO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-12°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four PtO₆ octahedra, edges with four PtO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-13°. There are two shorter (2.26 Å) and four longer (2.42 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Pt sites. In the first Pt site, Pt is bonded to six O atoms to form PtO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent PtO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-10°. There are four shorter (2.06 Å) and two longer (2.07 Å) Pt-O bond lengths. In the second Pt site, Pt is bonded to six O atoms to form PtO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent PtO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-10°. All Pt-O bond lengths are 2.06 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Pt atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Pt₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Pt atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Pt₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Pt atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Pt₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°.
